::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1870s?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mary Yonge Society/3
:::

My dear [Mrs Elgie](people/person_475.qmd)

I have a stupid cold in my head.  If it gets fine, I will come down at 2, if I see [Miss Davies](people/person_408.qmd) go by in the fly, but I thought she was not coming in rain.[^1]  If she does come, and the rain goes on I am afraid I must ask her to look in on me on her way, I should not mind the damp or this slight cold, only it makes [G](people/person_1462.qmd) so unhappy for me to go out

your affec
CMY

---

[^1]: Perhaps Miss Davies who was Diocesan Secretary of the Girls’ Friendly Society in 1878.
